entries.rationale: Pinned fork bug: its response enum is 0-based (SendPacks=1) while Cloudburst (Status ordinal: REFUSED=1, SEND_PACKS=2), PocketMine, and the reconciled Mojang+Endstone docs all place the pack list at wire value 2. The manifest layout is corroborated; the fork reads the list at the wrong tag. Fix belongs in the fork.
Oracle derives the response name string from the response enum on encode (resource_pack_client_response.go Marshal: resourcePackResponseToString), discarding the wire string; generated preserves it.
